snippet.title: Windows Wastelands: Q-Bob
snippet.description:
A video to go with the article for Q-Bob on my blog, The 90's Time Machine. If you want to read more about this game, go here:
http://90stimemachine.wordpress.com/2013/09/06/windows-wastelands-q-bob/


I just put this up to better illustrate how the game looks, sounds, and plays. Think of it as a visual aid! More videos will be coming up soon, hopefully, but they'll probably all be made to go with the blog. So keep an eye on it if you want the context!

This is basically just me playing the first few levels of this game to show off how it looks and plays. It's pretty good, if you like Q-Bert!
